Headline: Absolutely unacceptable accommodation

Positive: Nothing

Negative: Unfortunately, this accommodation was completely unsuitable for staying.
The property was extremely dirty and unsanitary. The toilet did not work at all, the tap in the sink was broken, there was no proper ventilation and there was a very unpleasant smell throughout the property. The dishes were dirty, and several amenities advertised in the listing were simply not available.
These were not minor inconveniences. The basic conditions necessary for normal living were not provided.
I contacted the property management in an attempt to resolve the problems, and I also contacted Booking.com support, but the issue was not resolved.
Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this accommodation and would strongly advise other travellers to consider these conditions before booking.

Headline: 

Positive: Très bon emplacement

Negative:

Headline: Bel endroit mais tarif élevé

Positive: L’emplacement
La vue face au golf

Negative: Indication d’arrivée autonome envoyée à 17h mais aucun réseau sur aucun de nos 3 téléphone . Nous avons dû faire 10 minutes de voiture pour capter et avoir les indications, faire des captures d’écran et revenir. Il n’est donc pas possible d’arriver pour 17h qui est déjà une arrivée tardive pour un séjour.
La salle de bain est vraiment vétuste, les lumières ne fonctionnent pas au dessus des lavabos, les tiroirs ne ferment pas et nous avons dû réparer nous même la douche pour se doucher. 
Pas de couverture, même si on est le 5 septembre, il fait frais la nuit. 
Une forte odeur de fosse septique. 
La peinture s’écaille autour des plaintes. Ce n’est pas de la première fraîcheur. 
Interdit aux animaux mais si on ouvre la fenêtre, un chat arrive directement chez nous. 
De voitures bruyantes passent devant notre fenêtre très tôt le matin.

Headline: It was one of the worst experiences of my life; I was taken advantage of financially and psychologically, and the whole

Positive: If you are looking for a place to find peace and quiet, forget it. I was treated very poorly; I paid nearly 500 euros for a week, and on Monday, the apartment owner made extremely serious, baseless accusations against me. He threatened to storm the apartment with the police if I didn't leave and refused to refund my money. The building hallway smelled of marijuana 24 hours a day. I ordered packages from Amazon and lost one of them; dealing with this host was nothing but a loss for me. There was zero privacy—I had rented the place for two people—and it was the worst experience I’ve ever had. To this day, he hasn't returned my money and acted as if nothing had happened, even though I was kicked out at 9 PM on that Monday and forced to find a hotel.
